title: Crunchy Walnut Cookies
description: A classic cookie recipe with the added crunch of walnuts. Perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk together flour, sugar, cinnamon, cardamom, and lemon zest in a medium bowl.
In a separate bowl, cream together butter and eggs until light and fluffy.
Add the flour mixture to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
Stir in the chopped walnuts and crushed cookies.
Scoop tablespoon-sized balls of dough onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving 2 inches of space between each cookie.
Bake for 12-14 minutes or until lightly golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
